title: Logo Color
slide_intent: Control the relationship between mark and background so color flexibility does not dilute recognition.
strategic_value: The two core colors and Mayo Egg White reversal can keep Burger King recognizable across contrasting fields.
demonstration: The full-color logo sits on a pale field beside a Mayo Egg White logo reversed out of a tall Fiery Red panel.
practical_value: Compare the normal two-color logo with the light reversed version before selecting a background.

content_islands.name: Core-color logo
content_islands.spec: Show the orange-and-red logo in the broad pale field.

content_islands.name: Reversed logo
content_islands.spec: Place the Mayo Egg White logo centered in the red panel at right.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that regulated color pairings maintain a consistent brand impression.
reference_purposes.Expression: The side-by-side logos demonstrate core colors and a pale reversal.
reference_purposes.Application: The page identifies the primary two-color appearance and Mayo Egg White reversal on colored backgrounds.

ingredient.name: Logo color relationship
ingredient.role: Retain recognition on different colored fields.
ingredient.application: Prefer the two core logo colors; use the specified Mayo Egg White reversal on a colored background.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; exact permitted combinations are further distinguished on the following usage pages.
